title: Super Cup ATTP – Summer 2024: Stage I registration
body_html:
Registration for the national table tennis tournament Super Cup ATTP – Summer 2024 (17-18 August 2024 / Top Cup Academy – Chișinău) has closed.

We wish the participants to put all their skill, resources and sporting potential into achieving outstanding results at this grand tournament.

May optimism and the will to win always be with you and drive you to be the best.
